```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
```


```{r Department Information Aggregation}

dept = c(
  "Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"
)

courses_df = data.frame()

for (dept_name in dept) {
  
  directory_url = paste0(
    "https://miamioh.edu/fsb/directory/?up=/query/all/all/",
    dept_name,
    "/all"
  )
  
  webpage = rvest::read_html(directory_url)
  
  department = webpage %>% rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(1)") %>% rvest::html_text2()
  name = webpage %>% rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(3) > strong > a") %>% rvest::html_text2()
  position = webpage %>% rvest::html_elements("tr > td:nth-child(3) > i") %>% rvest::html_text2()
  website = webpage %>% rvest::html_elements("tr> td:nth-child(3) > strong > a") %>% rvest::html_attr("href")
  
  df = data.frame(department = department, name = name, position = position, website = website)
  
  df = df %>% dplyr::filter(department %in% c("Accountancy",
  "Economics",
  "Entrepreneurship",
  "Finance",
  "Information%20Systems%20--%20Analytics",
  "Marketing",
  "Management"))
  
  courses_df = rbind(courses_df, df)}
  
head(courses_df)
```
